title: Today in one sentence
text: Tech stocks had a rough Thursday, with the Nasdaq 100 fund (QQQ) down 2.9% and the S&P 500 fund (SPY) down 1.2%, while Lockheed Martin, health companies and the dividend fund SCHD went up.

title: AI stocks took the biggest hit
text: Chip and AI companies fell the most today. AMD dropped 8.1%, Vertiv 7.8%, TSMC 4.5% and Nvidia 4.4%. When many stocks in the same group fall together, it often means investors are worried about the whole theme, not one company.

title: Meta fell after its report
text: Meta fell 7.0% to $648.85, the day after it shared its quarterly results. Sales grew 26%, but news sites say investors are uneasy about how much money the company is spending on AI. Even good sales can be overshadowed by big spending.

title: Lockheed Martin jumped 7%
text: Lockheed Martin rose 7.0% to $589.91 after reporting sales up 11% to $20.7 billion and a record backlog (orders not yet delivered) of $292 billion. It now sits above the $554 low end of analyst price targets, and a price target is just the average guess of analysts, not a promise.

title: Calmer stocks held up
text: While tech fell, the dividend fund SCHD rose 2.1% to a new 52 week high, Eli Lilly gained 2.8% and Intuitive Surgical 3.7%. Owning different kinds of companies, called diversification, helps soften days like this.

title: Lesson 19: What is a pullback?
text: A pullback is when a stock or the whole market drops for a short time after rising. Think of climbing a hill: you sometimes stop and slide back a few steps before you keep going. Drops of 5% to 10% happen fairly often, even in healthy markets, and a drop of 20% or more is called a bear market. Today the Nasdaq 100 fund fell almost 3% in one day, which feels big, but it is a normal kind of event. A pullback is a good moment to ask what you own and why you own it, not to panic. This is for learning, not advice to buy or sell anything.

title: Data coverage
text: Prices, 52 week ranges and sector changes come from FMP and show today's close (Thursday, October 22).
